headword: {画面収録|がめんしゅうろく}

definitions.explanation: The act of recording what is displayed on a computer or smartphone screen as a video. Used in tutorials, presentations, and sharing gameplay.

examples.japanese: {画面収録|がめんしゅうろく}の{方法|ほうほう}を{教|おし}えてください。
examples.english: Please tell me how to do a screen recording.

examples.japanese: {画面収録|がめんしゅうろく}で{操作手順|そうさてじゅん}を{記録|きろく}した。
examples.english: I recorded the operating procedure with a screen recording.

examples.japanese: スマホの{画面収録|がめんしゅうろく}{機能|きのう}を{使|つか}って、ゲームの{実況|じっきょう}{動画|どうが}を{作|つく}った。
examples.english: I used my smartphone's screen recording feature to make a gameplay commentary video.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of {画面|がめん} (screen) and {収録|しゅうろく} (recording). This is the term used in Apple's iOS and macOS interfaces. スクリーンレコーディング (the loanword equivalent) is also used.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {画面収録|がめんしゅうろく}{機能|きのう} (screen recording feature)
- {画面収録|がめんしゅうろく}を{開始|かいし}する (to start screen recording)
- {画面収録|がめんしゅうろく}{動画|どうが} (screen recording video)

RELATED WORDS:
- スクリーンショット: screenshot (still image)
- {録画|ろくが}: video recording (general)
